products.q: What products does National Machinery Stores supply?
products.a: We supply Mini Oil Expellers, High Capacity Oil Expellers, Screw Conveyors, Conveyor Belts, Casting Oil Filters, Plastic Oil Filters (Hydraulic), Vassal Oil Neutralizers, Radler Chains, Oil Expeller Spare Parts and complete Oil Mill Machinery. We also provide Oil Mill Erection, Demolition & Total Service Contracts, including AMC.

new-used.q: Do you supply both new and used oil expellers?
new-used.a: Yes. We deal in both new and used (refurbished) oil expellers and oil mill machinery. We also work as commission agents: if you want to sell a used plant or machine, we connect you with buyers across India.

expeller-size.q: Which oil expeller size do I need?
expeller-size.a: Size the expeller by daily seed input. A mini oil expeller handles 1–5 tonnes per day on 3–15 HP. A high capacity oil expeller handles 5–50+ tonnes per day on 20–75 HP and is built for continuous 24-hour running. Send your seed type and target tonnes per day on WhatsApp and we will recommend a model.

filters.q: What is the difference between a plastic (hydraulic) oil filter and a casting oil filter?
filters.a: The plastic oil filter uses lightweight polypropylene plates closed hydraulically; it is about 50% lighter, corrosion-free, reasonably priced and the best choice for new oil mill plants. The casting oil filter is heavy-duty cast iron and more durable for high-volume operations. We help you choose for your setup and budget.

vassal.q: What is a Vassal Oil Neutralizer used for?
vassal.a: A Vassal Oil Neutralizer is used in edible oil refining to neutralise free fatty acids (FFA) in crude oil with caustic soda, improving oil quality, colour and shelf life. It is the first step of the post-extraction refining stage, before bleaching and deodorisation.

radler.q: What is a Radler Chain used for in an oil mill?
radler.a: A Radler (Redler) chain drives an en-masse conveyor that moves bulk material such as oilseeds, cake, flour and granules through an enclosed trough without breakage or segregation. In oil mills it feeds seed to expellers and carries cake and meal away.

deliver.a: Yes. We supply clients in 18+ Indian states, including Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Odisha, and export to Africa and other international markets. Every order includes GST billing and transit-safe packaging.

install.q: Can you handle complete oil plant installation?
install.a: Yes. Our Oil Mill Erector, Demolition & Total Service Contract covers complete plant setup — civil guidance, machine installation, commissioning, operator training and ongoing Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC). Typical projects take 2–10 weeks depending on plant size.

spares.q: How quickly are spare parts dispatched?
spares.a: Stocked spare parts are dispatched within 24–48 hours. We keep critical parts — worm shafts, barrels, cages and bearings — in stock to minimise mill downtime. For urgent needs, send a photo of the part on WhatsApp for the fastest response.

line.q: Can you supply a complete line, not just one machine?
line.a: Yes. We supply every stage of an oil mill — conveying (screw conveyors, Radler chains, belts), pressing (expellers), filtration (casting and PP hydraulic filter presses) and refining (vassal neutralizers) — plus erection, AMC and spare parts, so one supplier is accountable for the whole line.
